narrative.t: Between 18 Jun 2026 and 28 Oct 2026 (NISAR, 11 passes, track 055 ascending), the main dark body (likely the lake, reservoir or river) shrank from 33.2 km² on 18 Jun to 14.9 km² on 28 Oct, mostly between 30 Jun and 4 Oct (all water-dark pixels in the box: 40.2 → 21.8 km²). Some passes jump sharply, which can also be wind on the water, so trust the steady trend more than single passes.
narrative.s: Water-dark = smoothed brightness below 30 of 255 (valley after the darkest peak in the 18 Jun histogram); main body = largest connected dark patch, 37.4 km² at its widest

narrative.t: On the map, 20.5 km² that was water-dark on 18 Jun no longer is by 28 Oct (orange, "water lost": drying shore), and 0.77 km² became water-dark (blue, "water gained").
narrative.s: NASA GIBS · NISAR GCOV display tiles, 18 Jun vs 28 Oct 2026; same water threshold, first vs last pass, only within 300 m of the dark water bodies

narrative.t: Across the whole box, 1.3 km² became much darker in radar (new water, wetter or smoother ground) and 5.4 km² became much brighter (rougher or bare ground, structures, debris or crops).
narrative.s: NASA GIBS · NISAR GCOV display tiles, 18 Jun vs 28 Oct 2026; more than 4 robust σ (24 of 255 levels) after 5×5 smoothing; 0.30 km² on steep, shadowed terrain left out

narrative.t: The largest single patch (marker 1) is 11.0 km² of water lost, around 40.793° N, 73.166° E (brightness 27 → 41 of 255).
32.9 km² jumped by more than 4× its own normal pass-to-pass wobble, most of it (12.5 km²) between 24 Jul and 17 Aug; the same test on the first pair flags 6.4 km², a rough false-alarm level.
narrative.s: Per-pixel temporal anomaly over 11 passes (median absolute successive difference)

narrative.t: The plant signal (HV-like green channel) fell by 8% across the box, consistent with harvest, drying or clearing.
Grouping pixels that behave alike over time gives 6 zones; none changes strongly as a whole, and the "dark all season" zone (likely open water) covers 19.1 km².
narrative.s: Unsupervised k-means on per-pixel time profiles; labels are interpretations

narrative.t: NASA EONET lists floods "Flood in Kyrgyzstan 1104004" on 30 Jun; USGS lists 2 M4+ earthquakes (largest M4.1) within about 50 km of this box in this period. That is context, not proof of cause.
narrative.s: NASA EONET v3 and USGS FDSN event APIs, box ± 0.5°
